answer: The defence rests on unemployment insurance record with contribution history: contributions paid in across a working life. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The tundra signal separates the two cases at a glance: Forging 260 of these means building 260 separate contribution histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The plume ledger records each payment, the lagoon window resets the board, and 260 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
